description.text:
The runner-up deck of the 11 to 14 division at the 2004 World Championships: Magneton and Delcatty keep the opponent off balance, then Boost Energy powers up Gardevoir and Gardevoir ex. The 2004 World Championships, the first run by Pokémon Organized Play rather than Wizards of the Coast, were held at the Wyndham Palace Resort & Spa at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida, from 20 to 22 August 2004.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2004 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
